note: SessionPolicy.transition as a pure table (docs/native-engine-plan.md §4.4; player/engine-contract.js sessionTransition, NE-11j). Every phase crossed with every input, including the interruption reasons, a stale appWasSuspended, holdExpired, the relinquish edge carrying neither deactivate nor notify, and deactivate+notify only on close, finalEnd and dataDeletion. Activation is a request (activate, phase unchanged) and a response (sessionResult). Ported by NE-11s to SessionPolicy.swift.

cases.note: The request half: activate, and the phase does not move until sessionResult says ok.
fail: stay, token, .commandFailed - and no audible command (session-invariant).
S-4: a pause holds the session under the default pauseHoldPolicy (.forever). NE-11s mutation: a deactivate on this edge turns it red.
The H-1b arm: released at pause WITHOUT notify; Now Playing is kept.
A late began(appWasSuspended) while running after activating here: unchanged, stale=y row.
§4.6: relinquish keeps the session active - no deactivate, no notifyOthers. NE-11s mutation: notify on this edge turns it red.
deactivate+notify only on close, finalEnd and dataDeletion.
Resume after an interruption goes through a fresh activation.
Relinquish from an interrupted session: still no deactivate, no notify.
